title: Tech Note: Relations for Beginners in 4D

historical_commentary.text: The fundamental relational concepts explained here (one-to-many, many-to-many, etc.) remain entirely valid and foundational in current 4D, though ORDA (introduced in 4D v17+) has since added a higher-level, object-based way to navigate relations that largely supersedes the older automatic/manual relation query techniques for new development, while the underlying data-modeling concepts carry over directly.
related_updates: ORDA (introduced in 4D v17+) provides a newer, object-based way to navigate relations between tables, superseding the older automatic/manual relation query techniques for most new development
